anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.

bible_refs.note: The Word was in the beginning — not 'the Word was first'.
The Son with the Father in his own glory.

choices.why: The Father alone is first as unbegotten source.

pass_a_gloss: For upon the Wisdom he takes the beginning and says the Word is not beginning but 'in beginning'. For when the Son is with the Father in his own glory he is not said to be first; for this is of the Father only; for God only is unbegotten, but the Son is not first [gap] that [gap] he wisely administers the whole, he is beginning.
pass_b_english: For in the case of Wisdom he takes the beginning, and he says the Word is not beginning [but] "in the beginning." For when [the Son is with the Father] in his own glory, [he is not] said [to be] first; [for this] belongs to the Father [alone]. For God [alone] is [unbegotten, but the Son] is not first [lacuna] that [lacuna] he wisely administers all things, he is beginning.
